items.title: 「被爆体験を直接聴くことができる最後の世代」 未来へ誓った平和
items.body_text:
「被爆体験を直接聴くことができる最後の世代」 未来へ誓った平和
広島は6日、米国による原爆投下から81年となりました。世界各地の紛争で大勢の人が亡くなり、核兵器使用のタブーも脅かされるなか、原爆の犠牲者を悼み、平和を願う人たちの動きを追います。
18:00
灯籠流し始まる
原爆で亡くなった人々を追悼し、供養する灯籠（とうろう）流しが始まった。平和を願うメッセージが書かれた色とりどりの灯籠が元安川を静かに流れ始めた。
15:50
中満泉・国連事務次長と若者らが意見交換
「国際平和のためのユース対話イベント」が広島市中区で開かれた。広島県や国連訓練調査研究所（ユニタール）などの主催で、中満泉・国連事務次長や横田美香知事らが登壇した。ユニタールのプログラムで、紛争のない世界の実現に向けての行動力を養う研修を受けた若者と意見を交わした。
14:20
「世界中の若者が教訓を未来へ伝えることが重要」
広島大が世界の主要大学に呼びかけた「第6回平和学長会議」が、広島大東千田キャンパスで開かれた。米欧やアジア、中東など11カ国・地域から17大学の学長らが参加し、平和学長宣言を採択。持続可能な世界平和に向けた大学の役割を議論した。
イラクアメリカン大学バグダッド校、イタリアのペルージャ大、フィリピンのビザヤ州立大、台湾の国立中央大などの学長をはじめ、米コロンビア大や韓国の延世大、東大や名古屋大も参加。広島大と教員養成で協力するエジプトのモハメド・アブデルラティーフ教育・技術教育大臣も来賓として訪れた。
広島大の越智光夫学長は「世界中の若者が広島の現実と教訓に触れ、未来へ伝えていくことがますます重要になっている」とあいさつ。平和学長宣言には、平和と持続可能性を推進する大学間ネットワークを育成・拡大し、学生と若手研究者の交流機会を拡充することなどが盛り込まれた。
13:30
「核被害に立ち向かう戦いの連帯」
世界の核被害者と広島をつないできた市民団体「核兵器廃絶をめざすヒロシマの会」（HANWA）が、広島市中区で「8・6ヒロシマ国際対話集会」を開いた。フランスによるアルジェリアでの核実験を取り上げた短編ドキュメンタリーの上映があった。「核被害に立ち向かう戦いの連帯」と題して、仏領ポリネシアの核実験被害者や、東京電力福島第一原発事故の被害者、広島の被爆者が意見を交わす。
12:30
原爆の絵「確かな日常を描きたかった」
広島市立基町高校の生徒が被爆者の証言をもとに描いた絵が展示されている「原爆の絵画展」（広島市中区）で、制作した生徒が作品を解説するギャラリートークがあった。
松原和花さん（2年）が描いたのは、原爆投下から30分ほど前の平穏な日常。幼い頃に被爆した滝口秀隆さんの証言をもとに、朝食後に玄関の外でめんこをしている様子を描いた。松原さんは「苦しみの中にあった楽しみ、悲惨さの裏にある確かな日常を描きたかった」と話した。
11:45
高市首相、原爆養護ホームへ
高市早苗首相は広島市東区の原爆養護ホーム「神田山やすらぎ園」を訪問した。首相は「若い世代に、つらかった体験を伝えていくということで、本当に貢献いただいているみなさまに心から感謝を申し上げる」とあいさつ。入園者に見舞金と花束を手渡した。
11:10
共産・田村委員長「核兵器廃絶への逆流に強く抗議」
共産党の田村智子委員長は平和記念式典に参列した後、記者団の取材に対し、「いかにして核の脅威から人類を守っていくのか、そのために核兵器の廃絶へどう世界が動いていくのかが問われる」と強調。そのうえで、高市政権内で非核三原則の見直しを求める声が出ていることを念頭に「唯一の被爆国の日本で逆流が起きていることに対して強く抗議をしたい。これほど『非核三原則を堅持してほしい』という声が起こるなかで、8月6日を迎えなければならないことは、かつてなかっただろう」と語った。
小泉進次郎防衛相が核兵器について「タブーなく議論」すべきだと発言したことについて、「今の高市政権のタガの外れ方が表れている」と批判。過去の核軍拡競争に言及しつつ、「世界にもたらす悪影響を真剣に考えてほしい」と訴えた。
また、日本政府は11月に始まる予定の核兵器禁止条約の再検討会議にオブザーバー参加をするべきだと訴えた。
11:05
首相、非核三原則の見直し「予断することは控える」
高市早苗首相は広島市内のホテルで記者会見に臨んだ。年内の安全保障関連3文書改定で、非核三原則を見直すかどうかについて「書きぶりについて、私が今、予断することは差し控える」と述べ、言及を避けた。一方、「非核三原則を政策上の方針として堅持していることは変わらない」とも語った。
3文書改定では日本維新の会が非核三原則の「持ち込ませず」について見直し対象とすることを求めている。
10:45
816人の名前を読み上げ
広島市の平和記念公園内にある原爆供養塔前で、納骨名簿を読み上げる集いが開かれた。約30人が参加。名簿に記された816人の名前を、分担して約2時間かけて読み上げる。
10:05
首相、「被爆者代表から要望を聞く会」に出席
高市早苗首相は広島市内のホテルで、「被爆者代表から要望を聞く会」に出席し、7団体の代表と面会した。冒頭、首相は「廃虚の中から立ち上がって多くの困難を乗り越えてきたみなさまの並々ならぬご尽力に、改めて深い敬意を表する」とあいさつした。
首相はまた、面会に先立って平和記念資料館を訪れたことに触れ、「あのような悲劇を二度と繰り返させてはならない。核兵器のない世界の実現に向けた国際社会の取り組みを日本が主導していかなければならない。改めて固く決意した」と説明。「我が国は被爆の悲惨さを自らの体験として語り伝えることができる唯一の国だ」として、「この体験の記憶を未来へとつなぎ、世界の人々と共有することが私たちの果たすべき責任だと考えている」と語った。
面会では広島被爆者団体連絡会議の田中聡司事務局長が、「私たちの政府が防衛力を強化するなかで、非核三原則の見直しや、核共有論が取りざたされている。非核三原則を見直すのか」と質問した。首相は「我が国は非核三原則を堅持している。核兵器のない世界を目指し、一歩一歩、着実に取り組みを進めていく」と述べた。
面会には上野賢一郎厚生労働相、国光文乃外務副大臣らが同席した。
9:30
「どうして12歳で死ななくてはならなかったのか」
広島市立第一高等女学校（現・市立舟入高）の慰霊碑前では、亡くなった生徒と教職員676人を追悼する式典が開かれた。藤本剛士さん（85）は、当時学徒動員で建物疎開の作業に出ていた姉の隆子さん（当時12）を亡くした。「どうして12歳で死ななくてはならなかったのか。今でも分からなくて悔しい」と涙をこぼした。
9:20
中道・小川代表、首相あいさつは「現状の説明」
中道改革連合の小川淳也代表は平和記念式典に参列した後、記者団に対し、核兵器禁止条約の再検討会議へのオブザーバー参加を政府に求めていく考えを示した。
小川氏は式典での高市早苗首相のあいさつにも言及。首相が「我が国は、非核三原則を堅持しており、唯一の戦争被爆国として、核兵器のない世界の実現に向けた努力をたゆまず続けていく使命を担っています」と述べた点について、「現状の説明にとどまっている。今後も堅持することへの決意をもう少し感じたかった」と語った。
また、高市政権内で非核三原則の見直し論がくすぶっていることに触れ、「大事な非核三原則に手をつけるように受け止められることは、平和国家としての価値を毀損（きそん）する」と述べた。
9:10
国民・玉木代表「非核三原則は堅持するべきだ」
国民民主党の玉木雄一郎代表は広島市での平和記念式典に参列した後、「日本は唯一の戦争被爆国であり、被爆の実相を伝え、核廃絶の先頭に立つ責任のある国だ」と語り、「非核三原則は堅持するべきだ」と訴えた。記者団の取材に答えた。
玉木氏は、高市早苗首相が非核三原則のうち「持ち込ませず」の見直しを持論としていることを念頭に、「『持ち込ませず』について様々な議論があることは承知しているが、核を搭載した艦船が（日本に）寄港すること自体がなくなっている。そうした（非核三原則の見直し）議論は、むしろ現実的な安全保障政策の観点から、少し遠ざかっている議論ではないか」と指摘。日本維新の会が主張する「核共有」についても「非現実的な議論だ」と批判し、自民党と維新の与党に対して冷静な議論を求めた。
9:00
首相、平和記念資料館を訪問
高市早苗首相は平和記念式典への出席後、平和記念資料館を訪問した。昨年10月の首相就任以降、資料館を訪れるのは初めて。首相は石田芳文館長の説明を受けながら約20分間、被爆して犠牲となった子どもたちが着用していた焼けた衣服などの展示を見て回った。
首相はその後、芳名録に「祈平和 令和八年八月六日 内閣総理大臣 高市早苗」と記帳し、資料館を後にした。
■■■平和記念式典■■■
8:00
原爆死没者名簿が奉納
広島市中区の平和記念公園で、平和記念式典が始まった。この1年で死亡が確認された人の名前を加えた原爆死没者名簿が奉納された。
8:15
原爆投下時刻にあわせ黙禱
平和記念式典で、原爆投下時刻の午前8時15分、参列者らが1分間の黙禱（もくとう）を捧げた。
8:20
市長が平和宣言
広島市の松井一実市長が平和宣言を読み上げた。宣言では、3回連続で成果文書の採択に至らず決裂した、5月のNPT（核不拡散条約）再検討会議の文書不採択に触れ「第三のヒロシマ・ナガサキを作り出すことになりかねない」と警鐘を鳴らした。

items.title: 「ホストに店で60万円使ってと言われて」売春の客待ち容疑、逮捕
items.body_text:
「ホストに店で60万円使ってと言われて」売春の客待ち容疑、逮捕
大阪・キタの繁華街の路上で売春の客待ちをしたとして、大阪府警は6日、神戸市東灘区の風俗店従業員（24）ら20代の女3人を売春防止法違反の疑いで逮捕したと発表した。
いずれも「手っ取り早く稼ぐためだった」などと容疑を認めているという。
逮捕容疑は7月14日～8月5日の間、大阪市北区太融寺町の路上に売春目的で立ち、客待ちしたなどというもの。
曽根崎署によると、風俗店従業員の女は6月ごろに売春を始めたと説明した。
「好意を寄せているホストから『俺の誕生日月には店に来て60万円使ってほしい』と言われた」
ホストの誕生日月は7月だったという。
店に行くたびに5万円前後を使ったり、ホストの自宅に行った時に4万円を渡したりもしていて、「風俗店の収入だけでは足りなかった」とも供述したという。
ほかに逮捕された大阪市福島区の無職の女（27）も府警の調べに対し、「最初はホストに貢ぐため、7年ほど前に始めた」と話した。
その後、美容室代やネイル代など、自分の金を稼ぐ目的に変わっていったという。
同じく逮捕された大阪市浪速区の無職の女（28）は「推し活」などが理由、と話したという。
「アイドルのコンサートや美容整形の費用を稼ぐためだった。約3年間で計7200万円ほど稼いだ」
太融寺町の一部の道路では、以前から客待ちが相次ぎ、問題になっている。
2024年12月、曽根崎署や地元住民が客待ちの多い道路約100メートルを黄色に塗るなどの対策を行った。
署によると、管内で24年に売春防止法違反容疑で検挙されたのは18人だったが、25年には11人に減った。
しかし、依然として後を絶たず、署は一斉取り締まりなどで対策を強化している。

items.title: 群馬のアイデア「パクり」 茨城県も観光パンフのパスポートを交付へ
items.body_text:
群馬のアイデア「パクり」 茨城県も観光パンフのパスポートを交付へ
群馬県が発行する「GUNMA（グンマ） PASSPORT（パスポート）」の人気にあやかろうと、茨城県は6日、「IBARAKI PASSPORT（パスポート）」の交付を今年10月上旬から無料で始めると発表した。来月にも発行部数や交付方法などの詳細を公表する。「グンマー」人気に続くことはできるのか――。
グンマパスポートは、群馬県が今年5月から交付を始めた、本物のパースポートに似せた観光パンフレット。県の観光名所などの紹介や、全35市町村の道の駅をめぐるスタンプラリーの証印を押すページなどで構成されている。
これまで4万部が発行されたが、人気のあまり交付申請が殺到し、一部は抽選になった。入手困難のため、ネット上では転売も起きていた。
SNS上で、グンマパスポートと、群馬県を秘境と揶揄する際に使われる「グンマー帝国」という言葉をかけ、「グンマー帝国に行くにはパスポートが必要」などと面白がる投稿が相次いだことも人気に拍車をかけたとされている。
茨城県の大井川和彦知事はこの日の定例会見で、「非常に優れた取り組みで、茨城も思いっきりパクり（まね）たい」。山本一太・群馬県知事にも了解を得ているとし、パスポートのサイズや全市町村をめぐるスタンプラリーの構成などは、群馬と同様にする方向で制作していると明かした。
表紙には、茨城県のVtuberキャラクター「茨（いばら）ひより」を起用。背景色は県章に使われている「いばらきブルー」にする予定だという。
大井川知事は「群馬のように人気がでることを期待したい」と話した。

items.title: 大手企業の夏ボーナス、過去最高104万円 建設は200万円超
items.body_text:
経団連が6日発表した大手企業の今年夏の賞与・一時金（ボーナス）に関する最終集計によると、組合員の平均妥結額が104万2537円だった。昨年夏に比べ7・04％増え、現行の集計方式を採用した1981年以降で過去最高だった。増加は5年連続。企業による「人への投資」の意識の高まりに加え、業績連動式の支給の導入が増えて好業績を反映した。
建設は約1・6倍の202万6633円。全業種で初めて200万円を超えた。全体の妥結額は、夏として2年連続で過去最高を更新した。
従業員500人以上で、集計可能な22業種163社を昨年夏と比べた。製造業126社の平均は6・23％増の109万3629円、非製造業37社が8・96％増の94万1145円だった。（共同）

items.title: 上場企業、最高益更新か 27年3月期、7年連続の増益
items.body_text:
上場企業の2027年3月期の純利益合計額が7年連続の増益となり、過去最高を更新する見通しであることが6日、SMBC日興証券の集計で分かった。前期比11・7％増の64兆6185億円になる見込み。AIブームに伴う関連製品の需要増や円安が追い風となり、業績を押し上げる。
対象は東京証券取引所の最上位市場「東証プライム」に上場する企業が中心。5日までに26年4～6月期決算を開示した555社（集計対象全体の49・9％）の実績や、6日以降に開示する企業の業績予想などを基に推計した。
業種別（555社）では、製造業が51・5％増の見通し。このうちAI向け半導体や製造装置などが好調な電気機器は2倍を超える大幅増益を見込む。（共同）

items.title: J1鹿島のクラブハウス移転検討 鹿嶋市が対案提出へ
items.body_text:
サッカーJ1鹿島アントラーズと茨城県潮来市がクラブハウスを同県鹿嶋市から潮来市に移転を検討していることに対し、鹿嶋市が同市内で建て替える提案書をクラブ側に提出する方針であることが6日、市への取材で判明した。2027年2月にクラブ側が移転の最終判断をする予定で、鹿嶋市の担当者は「なるべく早く（対案を）提出する」としている。
クラブハウスが老朽化しているため、クラブと潮来市は4月、移転検討を始めたと発表。鹿嶋市の田口伸一市長は「強い憤りを覚える。市を挙げて反対する」と撤回を求めていた。
潮来市では6月議会で移転の調査委託費を盛り込んだ補正予算が可決。調査を委託する公募型プロポーザルを実施し、今月5日に大手コンサル会社を優先交渉権者に決めたと発表していた。
鹿嶋市によると、7月に田口市長、潮来市の原浩道市長、クラブの小泉文明社長らが協議し、鹿嶋市側が対案を提出する意向を伝えた。建設費などの費用は確定していないが、潮来市よりも低い金額で提案する方針という。【井手一樹】

items.title: J1鹿島のクラブハウス移転検討 鹿嶋市が対案提出へ
items.body_text:
サッカーJ1鹿島アントラーズと茨城県潮来市がクラブハウスを同県鹿嶋市から潮来市に移転を検討していることに対し、鹿嶋市が同市内で建て替える提案書をクラブ側に提出する方針であることが6日、市への取材で判明した。2027年2月にクラブ側が移転の最終判断をする予定で、鹿嶋市の担当者は「なるべく早く（対案を）提出する」としている。
クラブハウスが老朽化しているため、クラブと潮来市は4月、移転検討を始めたと発表。鹿嶋市の田口伸一市長は「強い憤りを覚える。市を挙げて反対する」と撤回を求めていた。
潮来市では6月議会で移転の調査委託費を盛り込んだ補正予算が可決。調査を委託する公募型プロポーザルを実施し、今月5日に大手コンサル会社を優先交渉権者に決めたと発表していた。
鹿嶋市によると、7月に田口市長、潮来市の原浩道市長、クラブの小泉文明社長らが協議し、鹿嶋市側が対案を提出する意向を伝えた。建設費などの費用は確定していないが、潮来市よりも低い金額で提案する方針という。【井手一樹】

items.title: Irmão e irmã morrem após ataque de urso em campo na Índia; terceira vítima fica gravemente ferida
items.summary: O urso foi tranquilizado e levado embora enquanto um grupo de moradores cercava o animal
items.body_text:
Irmão e irmã morrem após ataque de urso em campo na Índia; terceira vítima fica gravemente ferida
Animal permaneceu ao lado dos corpos após o ataque e precisou ser sedado durante operação de resgate; autoridades investigam as circunstâncias do caso
Por O Globo — Chhattisgarh
Atualizado
Um irmão e uma irmã morreram e outras duas pessoas ficaram feridas após o ataque de um urso em uma área rural da vila de Largaon Markatola, no estado de Chhattisgarh, na Índia, na manhã desta quarta-feira (5). Segundo autoridades locais, as vítimas trabalhavam em um campo quando foram surpreendidas pelo animal, que rondava a região havia dias após um de seus filhotes ser encontrado morto nas proximidades.
Chamrin Jurri, de 40 anos, e Halalkhor Jurri, de 38, morreram ainda no local. A irmã mais nova, Khorin Bai, de 30 anos, tentou socorrê-los, mas também foi atacada e sofreu ferimentos graves. Ela foi levada inicialmente ao Hospital Komaldev e, devido ao estado crítico, transferida para um hospital em Raipur. Moradores que ouviram seus gritos correram até o local e tentaram afastar o urso com paus até a chegada de policiais e equipes do Departamento Florestal.
Segundo as autoridades, o animal permaneceu próximo aos corpos durante parte da operação de resgate e precisou ser sedado para que as equipes conseguissem remover as vítimas. O chefe de polícia de Kanker, Asharam Netam, afirmou que a ação foi complexa.
— O urso foi encontrado parado no local; ele se recusou a ir embora. A mulher ferida foi levada às pressas para o Hospital Komaldev, mas, como seu estado era crítico, foi transferida para Raipur para receber tratamento especializado. Toda a assistência possível será prestada à família do falecido — declarou.
A ex-chefe da aldeia, Annapurna Thakur, disse que moradores já haviam alertado as autoridades sobre a presença da ursa na região após repetidos avistamentos. Uma professora da comunidade, identificada como Ranjana, atribuiu o comportamento agressivo do animal à morte do filhote.
— A ursa estava extremamente agitada devido à morte de seu filhote. A ausência de um muro delimitando a área da escola representa uma ameaça constante — afirmou.
As autoridades ainda não confirmaram a espécie do animal, embora o urso-preguiça seja o mais comum em Chhattisgarh, estado conhecido por suas extensas áreas de floresta tropical e reservas de vida selvagem. Como medida de precaução, moradores foram orientados a evitar a região enquanto a situação é monitorada.

items.title: Barcelona não vê saída de autor do gol do título da Copa como 'um problema', e jogador pode fechar com o PSG
items.summary: Ferran Torres marcou o gol da Espanha na final da Copa
items.body_text:
Barcelona não vê saída de autor do gol do título da Copa como 'um problema', e jogador pode fechar com o PSG
Após brilhar no Mundial e decidir a final contra a Argentina, atacante desperta interesse do clube francês
Por O Globo — Barcelona
Atualizado
O futuro de Ferran Torres pode estar longe do Barcelona. Poucas semanas depois de marcar o gol que deu à Espanha o título da Copa do Mundo de 2026, o atacante entrou na mira do Paris Saint-Germain e pode ser negociado ainda nesta janela de transferências.
- Jogador da seleção de Uganda é morto a pedradas após reagir a assalto
- Fim da crise? Infantino pede desculpas, reconhece erros e tenta colocar fim à maior turbulência de sua gestão na Fifa
Segundo o jornal Marca, o diretor esportivo do Barcelona, Deco, aguarda um contato de Luis Campos, responsável pelo futebol do PSG, para saber se o interesse do clube francês será transformado em uma proposta oficial.
No Camp Nou, a possível saída do camisa 7 não é tratada como um problema. A diretoria aceita abrir negociações desde que receba uma oferta de, no mínimo, 50 milhões de euros (cerca de R$ 320 milhões na cotação atual).
A valorização de Ferran ganhou força após a Copa do Mundo. O atacante foi o autor do gol da vitória da Espanha por 1 a 0 sobre a Argentina na final e encerrou o torneio como um dos principais destaques da seleção campeã.
Apesar da boa campanha no Mundial, a avaliação do Barcelona sobre o jogador não mudou. Internamente, tanto Deco quanto o técnico Hansi Flick consideram que Ferran continua sendo um atleta importante para o elenco, mas não indispensável.
Na última temporada, o atacante marcou 21 gols em todas as competições, embora também tenha convivido com um jejum de quase três meses sem balançar as redes.
Outro fator pesa contra sua permanência: mesmo com bons números, Ferran nunca conseguiu se consolidar como titular absoluto, tanto na época de Xavi Hernández quanto sob o comando de Flick.
A situação contratual também favorece uma possível negociação.
Ferran tem vínculo com o Barcelona até junho de 2027, mas o clube ainda não apresentou uma proposta de renovação. A diretoria pretende conversar primeiro com o jogador para entender seus planos antes de decidir os próximos passos.
Caso o atacante manifeste interesse em permanecer, a renovação deverá ser discutida apenas em setembro.

items.title: Imagens inéditas do Sol revelam detalhes nunca vistos e podem ajudar a explicar um dos maiores mistérios da estrela; vídeo
items.summary: Imagens inéditas do Sol revelam detalhes nunca vistos e podem ajudar a explicar um dos maiores mistérios da estrela
items.body_text:
Imagens inéditas do Sol revelam detalhes nunca vistos e podem ajudar a explicar um dos maiores mistérios da estrela; vídeo
Registro mais detalhado já feito da superfície solar mostra redemoinhos de plasma que podem esclarecer por que a atmosfera do Sol é milhões de graus mais quente que sua superfície
Por O Globo — Rio de Janeiro
Atualizado
ientistas obtiveram as imagens mais detalhadas já registradas da superfície do Sol, revelando estruturas microscópicas que nunca haviam sido observadas com tanta precisão. A descoberta, publicada na revista Nature, foi feita com o auxílio do telescópio solar Daniel K. Inouye, no Havaí, considerado o mais avançado do mundo para estudos da estrela.
- El Niño pode deixar 49 milhões de pessoas em fome aguda, com forte aumento na América Latina e Caribe, diz ONU
- Veja mapa: Ondas de calor atingem Ásia, Europa e América do Norte em meio ao avanço do El Niño
Os registros mostram padrões ondulados e pequenos redemoinhos de plasma — semelhantes a ondas quebrando no mar — que surgem quando correntes de material superaquecido se movem em velocidades diferentes. Os pesquisadores identificaram essas formações como instabilidades de Kelvin-Helmholtz, um fenômeno físico conhecido em fluidos terrestres, mas nunca observado com esse nível de detalhe na superfície solar.
— Estas são as imagens da superfície solar com a maior resolução espacial já obtidas — afirmou Friedrich Wöger, cientista do Observatório Solar Nacional dos Estados Unidos e um dos autores do estudo.
Ao ampliar as imagens, os pesquisadores encontraram estruturas extremamente pequenas que lembram vórtices e ondas turbulentas.
Segundo David Kuridze, outro autor do trabalho, o nível de detalhamento surpreendeu até mesmo a equipe responsável pela pesquisa.
— Minha primeira reação foi: "Uau, como é possível vermos estruturas tão pequenas e tão finas no Sol?". Isso é algo que nunca havíamos observado antes — disse o cientista à BBC.
Os pesquisadores acreditam que esses movimentos desempenham papel fundamental na transferência de energia e na reorganização dos campos magnéticos da estrela. Com o acúmulo dessa energia, podem ocorrer explosões solares, ejeções de massa coronal e outras erupções capazes de lançar partículas em direção ao espaço.
Além do avanço científico, a descoberta pode melhorar a previsão do chamado clima espacial.
Tempestades solares intensas podem interferir no funcionamento de satélites, sistemas de GPS, comunicações por rádio e até redes elétricas em diferentes regiões do planeta.
— Queremos compreender a física do Sol nas menores escalas possíveis para prever melhor o clima espacial — explicou David Boboltz, pesquisador do Observatório Solar Nacional.
Entender como esses pequenos redemoinhos transportam energia poderá ajudar os cientistas a antecipar eventos extremos que afetam diretamente a infraestrutura tecnológica da Terra.

Madrasta (esq) e pai Igor Gustavo Veloso de Souza (dir) — Foto: Reprodução/TV Anhanguera
O advogado Igor Gustavo Veloso de Souza, pai de Gustavo Veloso Feitosa, de 3 anos, e a madrasta da criança, Kathellen Moreira, foram presos na madrugada desta quinta-feira (6), em Palmas. A prisão ocorre um dia depois de a Polícia Civil pedir à Justiça a prisão preventiva do casal suspeito da morte do menino.
Conforme apurado pela TV Anhanguera, os investigadores monitoravam os passos do casal e faziam campana no local onde eles estavam hospedados, na residência de um amigo de Igor, na quadra 407 Norte. Vizinhos perceberam uma movimentação considerada atípica e repassaram informações que ajudaram a equipe policial.
Ao notarem a aproximação dos agentes, os investigados acionaram o advogado, que informou à Delegacia de Homicídios e Proteção à Pessoa (DHPP) que ambos se entregariam. Após passarem por procedimentos no Instituto Médico Legal (IML), o pai da criança foi encaminhado para o sistema prisional e a madrasta para a unidade prisional feminina.

items.body_text:
Centro Cultural Ensaio oferece bolsas para curso de teatro — Foto: Divulgação
O Centro Cultural Ensaio está com inscrições abertas para a seleção de bolsas de estudo para o Curso de Teatro da instituição, em Salvador. As oportunidades são destinadas a pessoas de todas as idades e as vagas são limitadas.
Segundo a escola, a formação tem caráter profissionalizante e busca desenvolver competências técnicas, criativas e humanas voltadas para a atuação teatral. Durante o curso, os alunos têm aulas de interpretação, expressão corporal, improvisação, construção de personagens, trabalho vocal, dramaturgia e práticas em grupo.
A metodologia é baseada em atividades práticas e prevê apresentações ao público ao fim de cada módulo. Além das mostras artísticas, os estudantes também participam de projetos como o Cena Curtas e o Combate das Turmas, voltados à criação, pesquisa e experimentação teatral.
De acordo com o Centro Cultural Ensaio, a escola também oferece aos alunos a oportunidade de participar de montagens com temporadas em teatros de Salvador. Entre os espetáculos produzidos pela instituição estão "Auto da Compadecida", "Os Saltimbancos", "Temporada Final", "Lady Macbeth – Página 1606 do Livro..." e "O Beijo no Asfalto".
Fundado há 15 anos, o Centro Cultural Ensaio funciona no bairro do Garcia e também abriga atividades ligadas à dança, circo e música, além de apoiar produções de grupos e artistas independentes.
As inscrições para o processo seletivo das bolsas podem ser feitas pela internet, por meio do site do Centro Cultural Ensaio. As regras da seleção e os critérios para concessão das bolsas estão disponíveis na página da instituição.

Inscrições: Pelo site do Centro Cultural Ensaio
Público: Pessoas de todas as idades
Vagas: Limitadas

items.body_text:
Oito estabelecimentos de saúde são interditados pela Agefis na Aldeota e no Centro de Fortaleza. — Foto: Agefis/ Divulgação
Oito estabelecimentos de saúde localizados nos bairros Centro e Aldeota foram interditados pela Agência de Fiscalização de Fortaleza (Agefis) durante a Operação Check-Up, concluída da última sexta-feira (31).
Nesta primeira fase, realizada entre maio e julho, as equipes do órgão realizaram 262 fiscalizações, que resultaram na lavratura de 115 autos de infração, 137 notificações, 11 apreensões, entre medicamentos e equipamentos, além das interdições.
Entre os estabelecimentos fiscalizados, estão clínicas médicas e odontológicas, farmácias, laboratórios de análises clínicas, óticas, instituições de longa permanência para idosos (ILPIs), serviços de estética, estúdios de piercing e tatuagem, entre outros empreendimentos sujeitos à fiscalização sanitária.
Inspeções
Durante as inspeções, as equipes verificaram o cumprimento das normas sanitárias, a regularidade dos licenciamentos municipais, as condições de funcionamento dos estabelecimentos, o armazenamento, a comercialização e a utilização de dispositivos médicos, o gerenciamento de resíduos de serviços de saúde e a utilização de equipamentos, entre outros aspectos previstos na legislação.
Entre as principais irregularidades identificadas estão:
- funcionamento sem o devido licenciamento;
- falhas nas condições higiênico-sanitárias;
- armazenamento e comercialização inadequados de dispositivos médicos;
- descarte irregular de resíduos de serviços de saúde e
- utilização de equipamentos em desacordo com as normas sanitárias.
Conforme a Agefis, com a conclusão da primeira fase, a Operação Check-Up iniciará, nos próximos dias, a etapa de retorno aos estabelecimentos para verificar se as irregularidades foram corrigidas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
"Caso sejam constatadas pendências ou reincidências, poderão ser adotadas novas medidas administrativas previstas na legislação, conforme a situação encontrada em cada estabelecimento", disse a Agefis.

items.title: Por que ministro da Defesa diz que Brasil teria que só 'abrir o portão' aos EUA em caso de ataque (mesmo após alta de 13% nos gastos militares)
items.summary: Como o país pode ter aumentado tanto seus gastos e, ao mesmo tempo, continuar com dificuldades para manter equipamentos, treinar tropas e concluir projetos que se arrastam há décadas?
items.body_text:
Por que ministro da Defesa diz que Brasil teria que só 'abrir o portão' aos EUA em caso de ataque (mesmo após alta de 13% nos gastos militares)
  - Author, Thayz Guimarães
  - Role, De Brasília para BBC News Brasil
- Published
- Tempo de leitura: 9 min
"Abrir o portão." Foi assim que o ministro da Defesa, José Múcio, disse que o Brasil deveria reagir a uma eventual invasão dos Estados Unidos. "A gente não tem equipamento para enfrentá-los nem tem dinheiro para consertar o portão. Eu prefiro abrir o portão", afirmou, arrancando risadas dos presentes.
Múcio fez a declaração na terça-feira (4/8) durante um encontro da Confederação Nacional da Indústria (CNI) sobre transporte marítimo e indústria brasileira, quando defendia maior previsibilidade no orçamento das Forças Armadas.
Ela veio em meio a uma escalada das tensões entre Brasil e Estados Unidos. Em julho, Washington anunciou uma nova tarifa de 25% sobre a maior parte dos produtos brasileiros, e Brasília negou vistos a dois diplomatas americanos. Horas depois da declaração do ministro, o governo americano cancelou o visto da embaixadora do Brasil em Washington, Maria Luiza Viotti.
Apesar do tom bem-humorado, a resposta de Múcio expôs um aparente paradoxo.
Segundo o Instituto Internacional de Pesquisa da Paz de Estocolmo (Sipri), os gastos militares brasileiros cresceram 13% em termos reais em 2025, para US$ 23,9 bilhões — uma alta bem superior aos 3,4% registrados na América do Sul e aos 2,9% registrados globalmente.
Ainda assim, o ministro havia afirmado em junho que a situação das Forças Armadas era "precaríssima" e "incompatível com o tamanho e as potencialidades do Brasil".
Como o país pode ter aumentado tanto seus gastos e, ao mesmo tempo, continuar com dificuldades para manter equipamentos, treinar tropas e concluir projetos que se arrastam há décadas?
O que entra na conta do Sipri
A conta do Sipri inclui as despesas com pessoal (salários e benefícios de militares e civis, aposentadorias e pensões), projetos estratégicos e equipamentos (compras de armamentos, obras, pesquisa e desenvolvimento) e operação e manutenção.
No caso brasileiro, o instituto afirma que a alta de 2025 foi puxada principalmente por investimentos em desenvolvimento tecnológico naval e pelo aumento dos custos com pessoal militar.
Isso não quer dizer que todas as áreas das três Forças tenham recebido 13% a mais, nem que esse crescimento tenha se convertido integralmente em novos meios operacionais.
Dados do Sipri mostram que os gastos militares brasileiros correspondiam a 1,3% do Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) em 2016 e a 1,1% em 2025. Em termos reais, o valor gasto pelo Brasil em 2025 superou o de 2016 em apenas 1,6%, enquanto o total mundial aumentou 41% no mesmo período.
"A fatia do orçamento da Defesa destinada à modernização e a investimentos em pesquisa e desenvolvimento é muito diminuta, algo em torno de 6% a 8%, porque o percentual para custeio e pessoal acaba sendo elevado", afirma Hélio Caetano Farias, professor do Programa de Pós-Graduação em Ciências Militares da Escola de Comando e Estado-Maior do Exército (Eceme).
Recursos extras de um lado, bloqueios de outro
Nos últimos anos, o governo passou a financiar parte dos projetos militares por mecanismos diferentes do orçamento discricionário ordinário, entre eles o Novo Programa de Aceleração do Crescimento (PAC).
Em novembro de 2025, uma lei complementar abriu outro caminho: autorizou que despesas de capital com projetos estratégicos voltados ao desenvolvimento da indústria nacional ficassem fora da meta fiscal e do limite de gastos.
A medida passou as ser conhecida como um pacote de R$ 30 bilhões ao longo de seis anos, ou R$ 5 bilhões anuais. O valor, porém, é um teto, não um repasse automático. E o dinheiro só pode financiar investimentos de capital ligados aos projetos estratégicos previstos na lei, excluindo gastos com combustível, treinamento, manutenção rotineira ou pessoal.
A promessa de ampliar os recursos também apareceu em discursos

items.title: Como a Rússia manda soldados feridos de volta para a linha de frente na Ucrânia
items.summary: Documentos obtidos pela BBC News Rússia mostram que soldados feridos, em particular prisioneiros recrutados em troca de libertação, foram enviados de volta ao combate na Ucrânia sem as avaliações médicas previstas em lei.
items.body_text:
Como a Rússia manda soldados feridos de volta para a linha de frente na Ucrânia
  - Author, BBC News Rússia
- Published
- Tempo de leitura: 6 min
Depois de pisar em uma mina terrestre, Oleg Shikin foi levado ao hospital com estilhaços no crânio, queimaduras no rosto e na mão e ferimentos no olho esquerdo, no peito, nos braços e nas pernas. Parte de seu crânio teve de ser removida cirurgicamente.
Shikin havia se alistado para, em troca, ser libertado de uma colônia penal russa. Nos últimos quatro anos, enquanto a Rússia busca recrutar mais soldados para a guerra contra a Ucrânia, dezenas de milhares de presos fizeram a mesma escolha.
Após o tratamento, Shikin foi encaminhado para uma avaliação médica militar, que determinaria se ele estava "inapto para o serviço militar", condição que permite que soldados sejam dispensados durante a guerra.
A recomendação foi que ele passasse por uma nova avaliação depois de um mês de licença médica. Em vez disso, foi enviado de volta à linha de frente, com uma placa de titânio na cabeça.
O caso de Shikin é um entre dezenas revelados pela BBC News Rússia. Documentos judiciais disponíveis ao público mostram acusações recorrentes de que comandantes enviaram soldados feridos de volta ao combate, em vez de encaminhá-los às avaliações médicas exigidas por lei.
Segundo a lei russa sobre o Dever e o Serviço Militar, duas categorias de aptidão, "inapto" e "parcialmente apto", podem levar à dispensa antecipada. Elas devem ser determinadas por uma junta médica militar composta por clínico-geral, cirurgião, neurologista, psiquiatra, oftalmologista, otorrinolaringologista, dentista e, quando necessário, outros especialistas.
Como não havia sido avaliado por uma junta médica completa, Shikin alegou ao Tribunal Militar da Guarnição de Nijni Novgorod que havia sido tratado de forma ilegal. O tribunal aparentemente concordou e ordenou que seu comandante garantisse a realização da avaliação.
Mas é aqui que o rastro documental termina. Não há mais nenhuma outra menção a Shikin na internet — e não se sabe se ele chegou a passar por uma nova avaliação nem sequer se está vivo ou morto.
Muitos ex-detentos ficam presos às Forças Armadas, o que permite que sejam "cinicamente descartados" na guerra, segundo Sergei Krivenko, diretor do grupo de direitos humanos Citizen Army Law.
O Tribunal Militar do Distrito Sul, por exemplo, decidiu que os antecedentes criminais de Rustam Farzaliyev o impediam de deixar as Forças Armadas, apesar de ele ter sido considerado "parcialmente apto", devido a uma "doença socialmente relevante".
O ex-detento Vitaly Kamenyuk, por sua vez, afirmou que havia sido considerado apto para o serviço com base apenas no parecer de um neurologista e que lhe haviam negado uma avaliação mais formal, embora seu atestado médico original reconhecesse uma "lesão grave".
Voluntários comuns que perderam dedos ou têm condições como o vírus da imunodeficiência humana (HIV), tuberculose, câncer ou transtornos mentais foram dispensados por serem considerados "parcialmente aptos".
Mas os ex-detentos não são os únicos a reclamar das avaliações médicas.
Em 2022, quando centenas de milhares de reservistas foram convocados, o Ministério da Defesa da Federação Russa emitiu uma diretriz de guerra segundo a qual eles deveriam passar por um exame médico ao chegar às unidades militares, "para descartar doenças infecciosas, assim como ferimentos e enfermidades que impedissem a mobilização". Somente se o exame identificasse "inaptidão" eles seriam avaliados por uma junta médica completa.
Em documentos judiciais, o reservista Dmitry Yelkin afirmou ter sido considerado apto para o serviço apenas com base em seus registros médicos de 11 anos antes, seu estado de saúde atual não havia sido avaliado adequadamente.
Outra diretriz, assinada em junho de 2023 pelo então vice-ministro da Defesa Timur Ivanov, determinava que o médico de plantão ou até mesmo um paramédico da unidade militar, em vez de uma junta médica completa, avaliaria

items.title: Acusação de estupro, 'arma contra Lulinha' e Arthur Lira mais perto do Senado: os impactos de Alfredo Gaspar como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
items.summary: Deputado do PL de Alagoas foi escolhido após primeiras opções serem inviabilizadas devido à resistência de grandes partidos em apoiar senador
items.body_text:
Acusação de estupro, 'arma contra Lulinha' e Arthur Lira mais perto do Senado: os impactos de Alfredo Gaspar como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
  - Author, Mariana Schreiber
  - Role, Da BBC News Brasil em Brasília
- Published
- Tempo de leitura: 6 min
A escolha do deputado de Alagoas Alfredo Gaspar (PL) para ser candidato a vice-presidente na chapa do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), após sua campanha não conseguir atrair apoio de outros partidos, é uma tentativa de causar desgaste ao presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) explorando o escândalo do INSS e as investigações contra seu filho Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, conhecido como Lulinha, afirmam analistas políticos ouvidos pela BBC News Brasil.
Gaspar foi relator da CPMI do INSS, comissão parlamentar que investigou suspeitas de desvios nos benefícios de aposentados e pensionistas. Seu relatório final, que acabou rejeitado na comissão, pediu mais de 200 indiciamentos, incluindo a prisão preventiva de Lulinha.
Por outro lado, Gaspar também é potencial alvo de desgastes para a própria campanha de Flávio, já que parlamentares da base governista apresentaram em março, no contexto da CPMI do INSS, uma queixa-crime à Procuradoria Geral da República para investigar o deputado por um suposto estupro contra menor de idade.
Gaspar nega as acusações e, até o momento, não foram divulgadas provas contra ele. O caso está em apuração preliminar pela Polícia Federal.
Outro impacto da escolha do vice de Flávio, apontam os analistas entrevistados, ocorre na disputa pelo Senado em Alagoas, onde Gaspar aparecia como forte candidato a uma das duas vagas em disputa, ao lado do deputado Arthur Lira (PP) e do senador Renan Calheiros (MDB), que tenta a reeleição.
Lira, que foi importante aliado do então presidente Jair Bolsonaro quando presidia a Câmara dos Deputados, agora deve ter mais facilidade em conseguir uma vaga no Senado, já que Gaspar disputava com ele o apoio do eleitor alagoano à direita.
Pesquisas eleitorais apontam Flávio como o candidato mais competitivo para enfrentar o atual presidente em outubro. Veja as sondagens no Agregador de Pesquisas da BBC News Brasil.
A escolha do vice surpreendeu, já que Gaspar não aparecia entre os cotados. Além disso, havia expectativa de que a chapa seria composta por uma mulher, na tentativa de reduzir a rejeição feminina a votar em Flávio. Entre os nomes cotados estavam o da senadora Tereza Cristina (PP) e da ex-presidente da Caixa Daniella Marques (Repúblicanos).
No entanto, o deputado foi a solução encontrada após grandes partidos da direita, como PP e Republicanos, não fecharem apoio à candidatura de Flávio.
Ambos prefeririam manter a neutralidade na corrida presidencial, devido a divergências internas e ao foco principal nas disputas estaduais e na eleição para o Congresso Nacional.
"O vice escolhido reflete uma maturidade do Centrão, de entender que é melhor estar na eleição para o Congresso do que em uma eleição para Presidência. O Centrão não comprou a candidatura do Lula, não comprou a candidatura do Flávio. Isso deixou o Flávio sem opções".
O impacto 'Lulinha'
Após ser alvo de investigações envolvendo o escândalo do INSS, que até o momento não geraram acusações concretas contra Lulinha na Justiça, o filho de Lula voltou ao noticiário policial com a abertura de três novas investigações contra ele pela Polícia Federal.
Os novos inquéritos autorizados pelo Supremo Tribunal Federal apuram se Lulinha teria atuado para favorecer empresas indevidamente no governo do pai.
Fábio Luís nega qualquer ilegalidade. Em nota sobre o terceiro inquérito aberto na terça-feira (4/8), a defesa de Lulinha informou que seu cliente "comprovará, ao final, que não tem relação direta ou indireta com qualquer tipo de irregularidade, assim como fez no inquérito das fraudes do INSS, em relação ao qual esperamos um já tardio arquivamento."

items.title: Mob attacks Kano traffic officials following highway crash
items.summary: Angry youths attacked Kano traffic officials (KAROTA) after a highway crash, hospitalizing three. Learn more about the incident and public concerns. Read More: https://punchng.com/mob-attacks-kano-traffic-officials-following-highway-crash/
items.body_text:
At least three members of staff of the Kano State Road Traffic Agency, popularly known as KAROTA, were hospitalised following a mob attack by some angry youths on Wednesday.
The Public Relations Officer of the agency, Abubakar Ibrahim Sharada, confirmed the incident in a statement, a copy of which was made available to The PUNCH on Thursday.
According to the statement, the incident occurred when a Sharon commercial bus was hit by a trailer at Kwanar Dawaki town along Zaria Road.
“The 2IC of the KAROTA patrol team along Zaria Road, Ibrahim Abubakar Ibrahim, said the Sharon commercial bus was stopped by the team for a routine check when suddenly the truck driver, who was speeding, rammed into the passenger bus, causing it to somersault several times. As a result, many passengers sustained serious injuries.
“When they saw how some of the passengers were injured, the group (youths) launched an attack on the KAROTA personnel, inflicting serious injuries on them,” the statement said.
The statement added that the truck driver who caused the accident fled while attention was focused on rescuing the passengers of the commercial bus and the injured KAROTA personnel.
The Managing Director of KAROTA, Faisal Mahmud Kabir, appealed to members of the public to respect and assist uniformed personnel on duty to maintain law and order on the highways.
He said such officers should not be regarded as enemies of society but as government representatives working to ensure sanity in traffic management.
The managing director also commended KAROTA personnel for their sacrifice and commitment to the effective discharge of their duties.
Motorists plying major roads in Kano metropolis have, on several occasions, raised concerns over the manner in which KAROTA operatives mount roadblocks on major roads, with some alleging that the agency has also taken over sections of federal highways linking Kano with other states.
KAROTA officials, who wear yellow uniforms, are often seen mounting roadblocks, while some are accused of extorting motorists, especially commercial vehicle drivers.
Roads frequently associated with the activities of KAROTA personnel include Maiduguri, Hadejia, Gwarzo, Zaria and Katsina roads, all of which link Kano with neighbouring states.

items.title: From Ozil to James: World Cup stars Who earned blockbuster transfers
items.summary: Discover how players like Ozil, James, and Vozinha earned blockbuster transfers after their standout performances at the FIFA World Cup. Read More: https://punchng.com/2208757-2/
items.body_text:
The FIFA World Cup remains football’s biggest stage, where players have the opportunity to announce themselves to the world. Beyond the goals, drama and unforgettable moments, the tournament has also served as a career-changing platform for several footballers.
For many players, impressive World Cup performances have opened the door to major transfers, turning them from relatively unknown talents into global stars.
The latest example is Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha, whose heroics at the 2026 World Cup earned him a move to Chilean giants Colo-Colo at the age of 40.
While his journey from Portuguese second division football to one of South America’s biggest clubs is remarkable, Vozinha joins a long list compiled by BBC Sport on Thursday of players whose World Cup displays transformed their careers.
Marc-Vivien Foe: Canon Yaounde to Lens (1994)
Marc-Vivien Foe was not widely known before the 1994 World Cup, but his performances for Cameroon helped introduce him to a wider audience.
Despite Cameroon’s disappointing campaign in the United States compared with their historic run in 1990, Foe emerged as one of the team’s standout players.
His impressive display against Brazil attracted attention and earned him a move from Canon Yaounde to French club Lens on a free transfer.
Foe spent four seasons at Lens, helping the club win their first Ligue 1 title in the 1997/98 season. He later played for West Ham United, Manchester City and Lyon before his tragic death in 2003 during the Confederations Cup.
Gilberto Silva: Atletico Mineiro to Arsenal (2002)
Gilberto Silva became a household name after Brazil’s triumph at the 2002 World Cup in South Korea and Japan.
The midfielder played every minute of Brazil’s campaign after replacing injured captain Emerson in the starting lineup.
His commanding performances earned him a move to Premier League champions Arsenal, who signed him from Atletico Mineiro for about £4.5m.
Nicknamed “The Invisible Wall”, Silva became a key figure in Arsene Wenger’s team, winning two FA Cups and playing a major role in Arsenal’s unbeaten 2003/04 Premier League title-winning campaign.
Javier Mascherano: Corinthians to West Ham United (2006)
Javier Mascherano announced himself on the global stage at the 2006 World Cup, where he helped Argentina reach the quarter-finals.
His performances for Corinthians and the national team attracted interest from European clubs, leading to a move to West Ham United alongside Argentina teammate Carlos Tevez.
Although his spell at West Ham was short, Mascherano later joined Liverpool before moving to Barcelona, where he won two Champions League titles and several domestic trophies.
**Mesut Ozil: Werder Bremen to Real Madrid (2010)**
Mesut Ozil was one of the breakout stars of the 2010 World Cup after helping Germany finish third in South Africa.
The attacking midfielder recorded four goals and four assists during the tournament, catching the attention of Europe’s biggest clubs.
Real Madrid signed Ozil from Werder Bremen for around €15m in August 2010.
During his time at the Spanish giants, he won the Copa del Rey, La Liga and Spanish Super Cup before joining Arsenal in 2013 as the club’s record signing at the time.
James Rodriguez: Monaco to Real Madrid (2014)
James Rodriguez produced one of the most memorable individual performances at the 2014 World Cup in Brazil.
The Colombian scored six goals during his country’s run to the quarter-finals, winning the Golden Boot and earning a place in FIFA’s team of the tournament.
His stunning volley against Uruguay became one of the defining moments of the competition and later won the FIFA Puskás Award.
Real Madrid responded by signing Rodriguez from Monaco for about €75m, and he went on to win several trophies, including two Champions League titles.

items.title: AfCFTA signs $3.1bn customs modernisation deal to boost intra-African trade
items.summary: The AfCFTA Secretariat has signed a $3.1bn customs modernisation deal with Bergmans Security Consultants to boost intra-African trade and revenue. Read More: https://punchng.com/afcfta-signs-3-1bn-customs-modernisation-deal-to-boost-intra-african-trade/
items.body_text:
The African Continental Free Trade Area Secretariat has signed a 20-year, $3.1 billion concession agreement with Bergmans Security Consultants and Supplies Limited to modernise customs administration across Africa in a move aimed at accelerating intra-African trade, reducing border bottlenecks and improving revenue collection.
The agreement, signed in Abuja on Thursday, will drive the implementation of the AfCFTA Customs Modernisation Project, an initiative designed to deploy advanced digital technologies and customs infrastructure to support the continent’s free trade agenda.
The deal comes weeks after both parties entered into a Memorandum of Understanding to collaborate on transforming customs operations across Africa.
AfCFTA Secretary-General, Wamkele Mene, signed on behalf of the continental trade bloc, while the Chairman of Bergmans Security Consultants and Supplies Limited, Saleh Ahmadu, signed for the company.
Speaking at the signing ceremony in Abuja, Mene described the agreement as a major milestone in Africa’s quest to establish an integrated, technology-driven trading system.
He said the project would provide the digital infrastructure needed to implement AfCFTA protocols on customs harmonisation and trade facilitation, enabling customs administrations across the continent to improve efficiency, strengthen revenue collection and facilitate the seamless movement of goods without imposing additional financial obligations on member states.
Mene disclosed that about 50 African countries had already signed on to the initiative.
According to him, the project would support the AfCFTA’s ambition of creating a single continental market of about 1.3 billion people with a combined Gross Domestic Product estimated at $3.4 trillion.
“The Nigerian experience demonstrated that technology can transform customs administration. The success recorded gave the AfCFTA Secretariat the confidence to replicate the model across the continent,” Mene said.
He noted that the initiative was inspired by the success of customs modernisation reforms implemented by the Nigeria Customs Service through Bergmans’ digital solutions, which he said improved cargo clearance, enhanced transparency and boosted government revenue.
“The achievements recorded in Nigeria convinced us that this initiative can deliver similar results across Africa. This is an achievement that should make Nigerians and Africans proud,” he added.
On his part, Ahmadu said the agreement marked the beginning of a long-term investment that would reshape customs operations across participating African countries.
He said Bergmans would finance the entire $3.1 billion project under the concession agreement and deploy digital and physical customs infrastructure across the continent to modernise border operations, improve trade corridors and simplify cross-border movement of goods.
According to him, the project would introduce advanced non-intrusive inspection technology, integrated data centres and multilingual customs portals capable of supporting Africa’s official languages.
“Our experience in Nigeria has achieved remarkable success and attracted international recognition. It has become a model for customs modernisation across Africa, and we are committed to delivering a world-class customs ecosystem that supports the continent’s economic integration,” Ahmadu said.
The AfCFTA, which officially commenced trading in January 2021, is regarded as the world’s largest free trade area by the number of participating countries, bringing together 54 African nations under a single market.
The agreement seeks to progressively eliminate tariffs, remove non-tariff barriers and facilitate the free movement of goods, services and investments across the continent.

items.title: EFCC can freeze accounts for 72 hrs without court order – Spokesman
items.summary: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has insisted that its temporary restriction on an Osun State Government bank account was lawful and backed by provisions of the EFCC Act and the Money Laundering (Prohibition) Act. The post EFCC can freeze accounts for 72 hrs without court order – Spokesman appeared first on Vanguard News.
items.body_text:
The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has insisted that its temporary restriction on an Osun State Government bank account was lawful and backed by provisions of the EFCC Act and the Money Laundering (Prohibition) Act.
Speaking on Arise Television on Thursday, EFCC spokesperson and Director of Public Affairs, Wilson Uwujaren, rejected claims by the Osun State Government and the Nigerian Bar Association that the commission required a court order before placing the restriction.
According to him, the decision followed what the agency described as suspicious transactions on the account over the past week.
“As we indicated in the statement released by the Commission, we took that step to preserve the account of the Osun State Government.
“We observed in the past one week that activities on that account looked suspicious, and based on the mandate of the Commission, we took the step of placing a restriction on that account to preserve it,” he said.
Uwujaren clarified that the action affected only one account and did not amount to a freeze on all Osun State accounts.
“That restriction order does not mean that all the accounts of Osun State have been frozen. No. It is just a targeted restriction on one account of the Osun State Government,” he said.
He explained that the commission noticed multiple transfers from the account to several corporate entities within a short period, prompting the intervention.
“The essence, like I said, is just to preserve that account because we observed suspicious activities on that account in terms of the transfer of funds to a number of entities within one week.
“So we had to take that decision to place a restriction on that account, not minding the fact that there is an election process in place,” he said.
The EFCC spokesman argued that the agency would have been criticised if it had failed to act while public funds were allegedly being moved.
“We have the responsibility under the law to do so because if we don’t take that step and, for instance, funds are looted from the account of the Osun State Government, I’m sure the Nigerian public will also ask, ‘Where was the EFCC when those funds were being moved?’” he said.
Uwujaren maintained that the state government still had access to other accounts and could continue to carry out its operations, including salary payments.
“It does not stop the Osun State Government from running the government of the state because they have access to other funds in the other accounts that they have.
“In any case, the payment of salaries and other expenditures by the state government happens just once in a month. What we have done is not a blanket freezing of the account.
“It’s just a targeted freezing. Once we are satisfied that activities on that account are no longer suspicious, it will be lifted,” he said.
On the legal basis for the restriction, he pointed to specific statutory provisions empowering the commission to temporarily restrict access to an account.
“A number of people have asked whether the Commission has the power to do so under the law. I can assure you that we have the power to place a temporary restriction on an account.
“Section 34 of the EFCC Act and Section 7, Subsection 6 of the Money Laundering (Prohibition) Act 2022 give us that authority to take that step,” he said.
He added that the restriction could remain in place for up to 72 hours before the commission would need to seek judicial backing if it wished to extend it.
“The restriction order can last within 72 hours before we can come with a court order if we need to provide a court order,” he said.
The EFCC had earlier announced that it had been investigating the Osun State Government since March 2026 over the alleged fraudulent management of about N11bn in Ecology Funds, Intervention Funds and Federation Account Allocation Committee allocations.

items.title: US has ‘massive amounts’ – Trump dismisses reports of munitions shortages
items.summary: President Donald Trump said on Thursday the United States has a vast supply of munitions and threatened those who suggested otherwise with jail terms as his frustration with the Iran war boiled over. The post US has ‘massive amounts’ – Trump dismisses reports of munitions shortages appeared first on Vanguard News.
items.body_text:
US President Donald Trump speaks to reporters after stepping off Air Force One upon returning to Joint Base Andrews in Maryland on July 19, 2026. Trump is returning to the White House from New Jersey, where he attended the 2026 World Cup Final. (Photo by Mandel NGAN / AFP)
President Donald Trump said on Thursday the United States has a vast supply of munitions and threatened those who suggested otherwise with jail terms as his frustration with the Iran war boiled over.
The Republican leader lashed out on his Truth Social platform at media reports about the dwindling weapons stockpile, saying that the United States has “massive amounts of ‘munitions’ especially of certain types,” without giving further detail.
“Additionally, large amounts are being manufactured and shipped to the U.S. as needed. Defense companies are building the largest number of plants and factories in our country’s history,” he said.
The Washington Post reported that Trump demanded answers about the munitions shortages from Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth last Friday, when they attended a cabinet meeting at the Camp David presidential retreat.
Trump told Hegseth that he thought the munitions issue “had been fixed,” the Post reported, citing two unidentified sources familiar with the exchange.
Trump railed against the media reports, threatening on Thursday that “the ‘leakers’ of these treasonous statements are being hunted down” and “Long term jail sentences will be sought!”
CNN also reported that shortages of long-range guided missiles and air-defense interceptors had affected Trump’s strategy in the conflict with Iran, with the US military having “nearly exhausted 80%” of its stock of THAAD interceptors.
The Post also said that the shortages led Trump to call off fresh strikes against Iran, despite having threatened to hit the Islamic republic “very hard”.
White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt branded coverage of the exchange with Hegseth “FAKE NEWS!”
“I was at Camp David with President Trump and Secretary Hegseth. This literally never happened,” she wrote on X.
Chief Pentagon spokesman Sean Parnell said the reports about Trump’s clash with Hegseth and the weapons shortages were “equally fictional.”
Iran’s foreign ministry has denied there are any negotiations underway with Washington, even as Trump said Tehran was keen for a deal.
AFP

items.title: NCoS launches probe after inmate’s viral TikTok live stream in Ogun
items.summary: The Nigerian Correctional Service NCoS has removed the Officer-in-Charge of the Ibara Medium Custodial Centre, Abeokuta, Ogun State, along with two other principal officers, pending investigations into the unauthorised use of a mobile phone by a death row inmate who went live on TikTok from custody. The post NCoS launches probe after inmate’s viral TikTok live stream in Ogun appeared first on Vanguard News.
items.body_text:
By Omeiza Ajayi
The Nigerian Correctional Service NCoS has removed the Officer-in-Charge of the Ibara Medium Custodial Centre, Abeokuta, Ogun State, along with two other principal officers, pending investigations into the unauthorised use of a mobile phone by a death row inmate who went live on TikTok from custody.
The Service, in a statement issued by its Public Relations Officer, CSC Jane Osuji, said the Controller General of Corrections, Sylvester Nwakuche, ordered the removal of the affected officers to ensure a transparent and impartial investigative process.
The statement said the Service had noted with grave concern the media reports and public reactions trailing the viral live stream, describing the incident as a serious breach of custodial security and a violation of the Nigerian Correctional Service Act, 2019, the Service Standing Orders and other extant regulations governing custodial operations.
According to the statement, preliminary findings confirmed that the inmate was in unlawful possession of a prohibited mobile phone, which he used to access social media while in lawful custody.
“Preliminary findings confirmed that the inmate was in unlawful possession of a prohibited mobile phone, which he used to access social media while in lawful custody,” the statement read.
The Service said the phone has since been recovered following a search operation and secured as an exhibit for further investigation, while the inmate has been transferred to another facility where he is being held under enhanced security pending the conclusion of ongoing investigations.
It added that the probe had also identified security gaps that may have contributed to the breach.
Osuji said the removal of the officers was without prejudice to the final outcome of the investigation and was intended to demonstrate the Service’s commitment to accountability and institutional integrity.
The Service used the opportunity to highlight ongoing security reforms embarked upon by the Controller General since his assumption of office, aimed at eliminating security vulnerabilities and preventing the introduction of prohibited items into custodial centres, noting that the incident had reinforced the need for their full implementation.
“The preliminary findings from this incident has further reinforced the need for these reforms and has directed their full implementation and intensified compliance across all Commands and Custodial Centres,” the statement said.
While the inmate’s culpability has been established, the NCoS said investigations were ongoing into the possible involvement, negligence or complicity of any officer, inmate or external collaborator connected to the breach.
“The Service wishes to assure Nigerians that anyone found to have facilitated, aided, condoned or failed in their responsibilities in connection with this incident will face appropriate disciplinary and administrative sanctions in accordance with extant regulations,” the statement said.
The Service commended the vigilance of members of the public and the media in bringing the matter to national attention, while appealing against speculation as investigations continue.
“The Service appeals against speculation while investigations continue and assures Nigerians that it remains resolute in its constitutional mandate of ensuring the safe, secure and humane custody of all persons legally committed into its care through continuous reforms, professionalism and accountability,” the statement said.

items.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, alongside Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir, will undertake a visit to Saudi Arabia from August 6 to 8, the Foreign Office (FO) said on Thursday. In a weekly press briefing, FO spokesperson Tahir Andrabi said the two will be accompanied by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, who is currently in Saudi Arabia after concluding a visit to Jordan. “During the visit, the prime minister will meet Saudi Crown Pri
items.body_text:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, alongside Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of the Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir, will undertake a visit to Saudi Arabia from August 6 to 8, the Foreign Office (FO) said on Thursday.
In a weekly press briefing, FO spokesperson Tahir Andrabi said the two will be accompanied by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, who is currently in Saudi Arabia after concluding a visit to Jordan.
“During the visit, the prime minister will meet Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, and discussions will focus on consolidating the Pakistan-Saudi bilateral relationship and exchange views on areas of regional and international developments of mutual interests,” he said.
He stressed that the visit marked Pakistan’s “long-standing partnership” with Saudi Arabia, which he said was “anchored in decades of mutual trust, cooperation and brotherhood”.
Andrabi noted that while the visit was taking place amid heightened tensions in the Gulf, he said that “it will carry immense significance beyond the immediate crisis and short-term considerations”.
He added that the visit will “further strengthen bilateral relations, deepen strategic cooperation, enhance coordination on regional and international issues of mutual interest and also reinforce multilateral cooperation”.
Shortly after, an official statement regarding the visit was also issued.
The premier had last visited Saudi Arabia in April, meeting with the kingdom’s top leadership.
As the Middle East conflict has expanded across new fronts, Saudi Arabia has unveiled plans for a multinational maritime defence coalition to protect shipping and energy supply routes in the Red Sea region. Fourteen countries, including Pakistan, have voiced support for the coalition.
In July, Pakistan also endorsed Saudi Arabia’s air strikes in Iraq as an exercise of its right to self-defence. The remarks came two days after Saudi Arabia and the US carried out coordinated strikes against installations of Iraq’s Popular Mobilisation Units, accusing elements within the umbrella force of launching attacks on Saudi oil facilities.
The remarks followed Pakistan’s earlier warning after Yemen’s Houthi rebels announced a maritime blockade targeting shipping linked to Saudi Arabia. Islamabad had then described attacks on Pakistani maritime interests as a “red line”, warning that any hostile action against Pakistani-flagged vessels or commercial shipping would be treated as an attack on Pakistan.
The country also simultaneously reaffirmed its commitment to Saudi Arabia’s security and the uninterrupted flow of lawful maritime commerce through the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandeb.
Last year, Islamabad and Riyadh concluded a Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement, which became operational earlier this year as Pakistan simultaneously embarked on a diplomatic effort to mediate between Iran and the United States.

The Foreign Office (FO) said on Thursday that India had “neither the standing nor the moral authority” to comment on the elections in Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK), which are being held in phases amid security concerns and unrest in the region.
FO spokesperson Tahir Andrabi made the remarks while addressing a weekly press briefing, where he was asked about the Indian External Affairs Ministry’s (MEA) “reaction” to the ongoing polls. While the question did not elaborate further, the Indian ministry had termed the polls a “farce” on Tuesday, saying that such “hollow exercises” could not hide the reality.
“Pakistan categorically rejects the baseless and politically motivated remarks of the Indian MEA regarding the ongoing legislative elections in the AJK,” Andrabi said on Thursday.
“It is unsurprising that India has chosen to issue such remarks on the eve of the 7th anniversary of its illegal and unilateral actions of August 5, through which it seeks to alter the internationally recognised disputed status of Jammu and Kashmir,” he said, adding that actions violated the relevant UN Security Council (UNSC) resolutions, international law, and India’s international commitments.
Andrabi held that elections in AJK were being conducted in a “peaceful, transparent and orderly manner” in accordance with the constitutional and legal framework governing the region.
He added that the ongoing elections reflected “democratic aspirations and political will of the people of AJK”.
Andrabi maintained that India, in view of its continued denial of fundamental political rights and democratic freedom in occupied Kashmir, “has neither the standing nor the moral authority to comment on the democratic process in AJK”.
He added that misinformation and propaganda could not change the status of occupied Kashmir, which remained a disputed territory.
“Its final disposition is to be determined in accordance with relevant UNSC resolutions as well as the freely expressed will of the Kashmiri people and through a UN-administered plebiscite,” he said.
He also held that India’s “attempt to invoke misleading casualty figures” cannot obscure its own actions in occupied Kashmir.
Andrabi said such statements were an attempt to deflect international attention away from India’s “continued violation of international human rights and humanitarian law and its persistent failure to fulfil international obligations”.
At this, he called on the neighbouring India to reverse its illegal actions of August 5, 2019 and “create an environment conducive to peaceful settlement in accordance with the relevant UNSC resolutions”.
The FO spokesperson was also asked about the Indian ministry’s response to comments made by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar on the occasion of Youm-i-Istehsal wherein it had condemned Pakistan’s “desperate peddling of falsehoods”.
He held that the Indian MEA statement was a “self-serving eulogy” for its actions in the occupied Kashmir.
“The reality is that a prolonged and heavy military presence, coupled with draconian laws, continues to facilitate demographic change aimed at altering the territory’s Muslim majority character.”

items.body_text:
KARACHI: A Karachi court on Thursday allowed the exhumation of Institute of Business Administration (IBA) graduate Mir Raza Ali’s body, which was found last month with a gunshot wound to the chest in the bushes in Gulistan-i-Jauhar.
The court issued the order on an application filed by Ali’s father, after a controversy emerged between the Karachi police surgeon and investigators over alleged loopholes in the medico-legal report regarding the post-mortem examination.
In its order, the court directed the police surgeon and the Sindh health secretary to constitute a medico-legal board for the exhumation of Ali’s body “under intimation to this court at the earliest possible date and time”.
The court order, issued after the ruling by Judicial Magistrate Hameedullah, stated that Ali’s father, Mir Hussain Ali Khan, had filed an application seeking the exhumation of his son’s body in accordance with law.
He also requested the formation of a medico-legal board, comprising senior forensic experts and pathologists, under the Karachi police surgeon “to conduct a fresh and comprehensive” medico-legal examination and postmortem, as well as X-ray, DNA, forensic and chemical examination of the body to ascertain the actual cause of death.
More to follow

The magic has officially run out–and Selena Gomez is feeling every bit of it.

Sharing a cast photo from the set, the Who Says crooner wrote, “Time to cast one final spell. The Wizards Beyond Waverly Place 4-Part Finale Event is now streaming on Disney+.”
She also reposted an Entertainment Tonight interview where saying goodbye to the beloved character proved harder than expected.
“This is it. This is the end of Wizards of Waverly Place, the end of Wizards Beyond Waverly Place. And it's really surreal to say that I'm done playing this character,” Gomez admitted.
Fans wasted no time flooding social media with emotional reactions.
“Definitely not ready to say goodbye,” one viewer commented.
Another added, “Gone too soon. wishing we had more seasons! I’m not ready to say byeee,” while a third wrote, “Thanks for bringing back my all time favorite Disney channel show. Thanks for the Magic.”
Premiering in October, Wizards Beyond Waverly Place reunited Gomez with original stars including David Henrie, Maria Canals-Barrera and David DeLuise while introducing a new generation of wizards.
Now, after three seasons, the Disney sequel has cast its final spell.
For longtime fans who grew up with Russo family, the finale is not just the end of another TV series–it’s the closing chapter of one of Disney Channel’s most beloved franchises.

items.summary: ‘Obsession’ star Inde Navarrette shares Oscar childhood memories
items.body_text:
‘Obsession’ star Inde Navarrette shares Oscar childhood memories
- By Sarah Brohi -
- Aug 06, 2026
Obsession actress Inde Navarrette reflected on the Academy Awards with her family as a child.
In a recent interview with Variety, the actress recalled those early experiences during the “Power of Young Hollywood” event. She also stated, “What’s really cool is that the Australian side of my family has been watching the Academy Awards since I was like 5.”
Navarrette specifically remembered watching Hugh Jackman host the ceremony and perform a theatre number. She also stated, “So I remember the earlier ones where Hugh Jackman hosted, and he did his big theatre number”.
The actress now faces the possibility of experiencing the ceremony from inside the theatre herself if she receives an invitation. “If I’m even invited, it’ll be so cool to sit in that theater and experience in real life what I’ve loved watching,” she said. “So it’s just so cool.”
Read More: ‘Obsession’ star Inde Navarrette just got one of the rarest gifts ever
According to the source, Obsession has become a major commercial success, reportedly earning more than $459 million worldwide from a production budget of about $750,000. The film has also generated awards-season momentum for Navarrette’s performance as Nikki Freeman.
Navarrette has already won Best Performance at the Seattle International Film Festival, adding to recognition for her work in the film. A potential Academy Award nomination would also mark significant recognition for a horror performance, a genre that has historically received limited attention from major awards bodies.
Whether Navarrette ultimately receives a nomination remains uncertain, but her performance has placed her among the names being discussed during the current awards season.
Inde Navarrette says it’s “so cool” to be in the Oscars conversation for her performance in “Obsession”:
“If I’m even invited, it’ll be so cool to sit in that theater and experience in real life what I’ve loved watching.” pic.twitter.com/vqzDNbX1lC
— Variety (@Variety) August 6, 2026

items.title: Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes’ daughter Suri makes theatre debut
items.summary: Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes’ daughter Suri makes theatre debut
items.body_text:
Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes' daughter Suri makes theatre debut
- By Umaima Amir -
- Aug 06, 2026
Suri Noelle – the daughter of actors Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise – has made her theatrical debut at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival as she stepped into the spotlight in a modern adaptation of William Shakespeare’s A Midsummer Night’s Dream.
The 20-year-old is part of the cast of Midsummer!, a queer reimagining of the classic play that is scheduled for a 13-day run at the renowned arts festival.
Ahead of the production’s opening, Suri was seen attending a dress rehearsal alongside her fellow performers from Carnegie Mellon University School of Drama in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
For the production, Suri wore a yellow shirt paired with a purple corset, matching skirt and a pillbox fascinator as she prepared for her first stage performance.
The show is described by its creators as “bursting with queer transformative joy” and marks the beginning of Suri’s professional theatre journey after graduating from New York City’s Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts. She is currently studying at Carnegie Mellon University.
The stage production also comes after it was reported that Suri had legally adopted “Noelle”- her mother Katie Holmes’ middle name – as her surname.
Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise welcomed Suri in 2006 before ending their six-year marriage in 2012. Following the divorce, Holmes was granted custody of their daughter, who has largely remained out of the public eye while pursuing her education.

items.title: Mir Raza Ali: Court approves plea for exhumation of body
items.summary: Mir Raza Ali: Court approves plea for exhumation of body
items.body_text:
Mir Raza Ali: Court approves plea for exhumation of body
- By Farooq Sami -
- Aug 06, 2026
KARACHI: A judicial court in Karachi has approved the request for the exhumation of Mir Raza Ali’s body as part of the ongoing investigation into the case.
The father of late businessman Mir Raza Ali moved Karachi court to seek the exhumation of his son’s body for a fresh post-mortem examination.
Mir Hussain Ali, the father of the deceased, told the court that he rejected the police investigation conducted so far as well as the initial post-mortem report, and requested that his son’s body be exhumed to determine the actual cause of death.
Judicial Magistrate East issued a written order directing the Secretary of Health to constitute a medical board to oversee the exhumation process.
The court instructed the authorities to implement the order as soon as possible, emphasizing that the exhumation should be carried out under the supervision of the medical board in accordance with legal procedures.
Read more: Mir Raza case: Karachi police surgeon raises objections over post-mortem report
The order is aimed at facilitating further forensic examination as part of the investigation.
Speaking exclusively to ARY News, he rejected the possibility of suicide, claiming his son was murdered and that the family was being subjected to a media trial.
He said the post-mortem examination was completed and the body was handed over to the family within an hour, raising questions over the investigation process and demanding a transparent inquiry into the death.
“My son was a businessman and owned four shops,” he said, adding that Mir Raza Ali was his only child.

items.title: Matric results 2026: Punjab boards reveal scores
items.summary: Boards announce SSC results with digital access through websites and SMS. The post Matric results 2026: Punjab boards reveal scores appeared first on BOL News.
items.body_text:
LAHORE: After months of preparation, anticipation and wait, thousands of students across Punjab finally received their matriculation results on Thursday as all nine Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education announced the SSC Part-II First Annual Examination 2026 results.
The results were released simultaneously by the boards of Lahore, Bahawalpur, Dera Ghazi Khan, Faisalabad, Gujranwala, Multan, Rawalpindi, Sahiwal and Sargodha, with students able to check their scores through official websites and SMS services.
The announcement brought a major academic milestone for students, while several boards recorded pass percentages above 60% in the annual examinations.
The Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education Lahore reported a success rate of more than 64%. According to the board spokesperson, 282,308 candidates appeared in the examinations, out of which 182,186 students successfully passed.
In a move towards digital advancement, BISE Lahore introduced an artificial intelligence-powered chatbot to provide students with instant access to their results. Students can check their marks by entering their six-digit roll number on the board’s chatbot platform.
Read More: Section 144 imposed in Karachi during SSC exams
The Lahore Board said the initiative reflects its commitment to digital transformation and improving public services through modern technology.
The Rawalpindi Board announced that 120,411 candidates appeared in the examinations, while 73,829 students were declared successful, achieving an overall pass percentage of 61.31%.
Female students secured a higher success rate in Rawalpindi, with 70.18% passing compared to 51.99% among male candidates.
The Multan Board recorded a pass percentage of 65.72%, with 96,638 students passing out of 133,019 candidates who appeared in the exams.
Meanwhile, the Bahawalpur Board reported a 65.47% success rate, as 63,012 students passed out of 96,245 candidates.
In the Bahawalpur Board, Abdul Haseeb from Government Abbasia Higher Secondary School secured the first position with 1,186 marks. Muzammil Bilal claimed the second position with 1,184 marks.
Javeria Fatima from Umm-ul-Qura Public Girls High School and Iman Fatima Malik from Government Girls Higher Secondary School Model Town jointly secured third position after scoring 1,183 marks each.
Students can access their SSC Part-II First Annual Examination 2026 results through their respective board websites or SMS services.

items.title: New visa rules pose revenue risks for U.S. colleges reliant on international students
items.summary: New regulatory changes to U.S. student visa policies could create financial headwinds for American colleges and universities that depend heavily on international enrollment, according to a new analysis from Fitch Ratings. While the firm expects the broader higher-education sector to weather the storm, institutions with significant exposure to foreign student tuition may face sustained revenue ... Read more The post New visa rules pose revenue risks for U.S. colleges reliant on international stud
items.body_text:
New regulatory changes to U.S. student visa policies could create financial headwinds for American colleges and universities that depend heavily on international enrollment, according to a new analysis from Fitch Ratings.
While the firm expects the broader higher-education sector to weather the storm, institutions with significant exposure to foreign student tuition may face sustained revenue pressure and weakened financial flexibility.
The policy shift, which replaces the longstanding “duration of status” framework with a strict four-year limit on F-1 visas, introduces new hurdles for international students. Under the upcoming rules, extensions will require case-by-case approval from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, the post-completion grace period will be shortened, and program-change restrictions will tighten.
Though legal challenges from education and immigration advocacy groups could delay or alter implementation, the uncertainty is already rippling through campuses and recruitment strategies.
The Revenue Ripple Effect
International students are a critical financial pillar for many U.S. institutions, often paying full tuition with minimal institutional aid. That makes them hard to replace on short notice, especially amid domestic demographic declines and lengthy recruitment cycles. With high fixed costs, even a modest dip in enrollment can erode operating margins and debt-service coverage for vulnerable schools.
Fitch warns that the most acute credit pressure will fall on colleges already grappling with weak demand profiles, limited financial cushions, heavy tuition dependence, and international student bodies comprising 10% to 15% or more of total enrollment. Graduate programs and STEM fields, where degree completion frequently exceeds four years, face added costs and recruitment challenges under the new extension requirements.
Sector-Wide Impact Limited, But Divergence Grows
Despite the risks, Fitch expects the credit impact across the entire sector to remain contained. Top-rated institutions, particularly those with diversified revenue streams and robust financial reserves, are better positioned to absorb moderate enrollment volatility.
However, the ratings agency highlights a growing divergence in financial reliance on student fees. For example, ‘A’ and ‘BBB’ rated private colleges remain the most dependent, with student fees accounting for roughly 77% of adjusted operating revenue in fiscal 2025.
By contrast, ‘AAA’ rated private schools derive only 26.2% of revenue from tuition and fees. Among public universities, higher-rated ‘AAA’ and ‘AA’ institutions have actually reduced their fee reliance over the past five years, while lower-rated ‘A’ and ‘BBB’ public schools have seen their dependence grow to nearly 34%.
Enrollment Trends Shift
While international students still represent a modest share, 6.1% of the total U.S. student population in the 2024–2025 academic year, per Open Door data, recent trends are concerning. That figure marked a 4.5% increase year-over-year, but the momentum reversed in fall 2025, with overall international numbers dipping 1% and new international student arrivals plummeting 17%.
Campus Responses: Broader Nets, New Pathways, and Budget Cuts
In response to tightening visa rules and enrollment uncertainty, U.S. colleges are adapting. Many are broadening recruitment beyond traditional source countries to reduce over-reliance on a few markets. Others are forging partnerships with foreign institutions to offer online or overseas coursework, allowing students to begin their studies abroad before transferring stateside. At the same time, financial pressure is prompting spending restraint—with some universities already announcing job cuts and budget reductions amid broader funding challenges.
As the legal and regulatory landscape continues to evolve, the coming months will be critical for both prospective international students and the institutions that count on them.

items.title: Regular exercise linked to lower stroke risk among AFib patients
items.summary: People who developed AFib during the study were moved into the AFib group to keep results accurate. The post Regular exercise linked to lower stroke risk among AFib patients appeared first on BOL News.
items.body_text:
Regular exercise linked to lower stroke risk among AFib patients
				
				
					
People who developed AFib during the study were moved into the AFib group to keep results accurate.
				
		
				 
				
					
Adults with an irregular heartbeat condition called atrial fibrillation, or AFib can lower their risk of stroke and death simply by staying physically active, according to a new study in the Journal of the American Heart Association.
Researchers in Norway tracked more than 87,000 adults for about 15 years, pulling data from national health registries to study links between exercise, AFib, stroke and death. More than 6,500 participants in the study had AFib, a condition that causes the heart’s upper chambers to quiver or beat irregularly and can lead to blood clots and stroke.
Compared with inactive adults, those with low, moderate or high activity levels had a 9%, 19% and 18% lower risk of stroke, respectively. Death risk from any cause also dropped, falling 11%, 18% and 22% for low, moderate and high activity levels. Those benefits held steady whether or not a person had AFib, suggesting the condition doesn’t change how exercise protects the body.
For people with AFib specifically, staying active was linked to living half a year to more than a year longer than those who stayed inactive.
Johansen, a researcher at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, said he hopes the results push doctors and patients to recognize that even small amounts of movement help. He added that health benefits can start at any point someone decides to get active, and some exercise always beats none.
The study sorted participants into four activity groups based on how often, how long and how intensely they exercised. People who developed AFib during the study were moved into the AFib group to keep results accurate.
